title: Google Finance Indices Scraper
description: Fetch multiple Google Finance indices in one run. Use a JSON array or comma-separated symbols.

indices.title: Index symbols
indices.description: A comma-separated list or JSON array of up to 50 symbols, for example .INX, .DJI, .IXIC. Arrays are validated at runtime.

hl.title: Language
hl.description: Google Finance language code, such as en or de.

gl.title: Country
gl.description: Two-letter Google Finance country code, such as us or de.
